# Journal: 2026-01-17

## Learnings

### 08:45 | [learning] WebSocket connection pooling needs heartbeat mechanism
- **Context**: Real-time collaboration feature dropping connections after 60s idle
- **Insight**: Load balancers (ALB, nginx) close idle WebSocket connections. Need a ping/pong heartbeat every 30s to keep connections alive.
- **Evidence**: ALB access logs showed connection resets at exactly 60s intervals
- **Tags**: #websocket #networking #aws #load-balancer

## Decisions

### 10:00 | Use SQLite for the embedded analytics engine
- **Options**: SQLite (embedded), DuckDB (columnar), PostgreSQL (external)
- **Chose**: SQLite
- **Rationale**: Zero deployment complexity, good enough for <10M rows, WAL mode handles concurrent reads well
- **Revisit if**: Dataset exceeds 10M rows or need columnar analytics (switch to DuckDB)
